story.title: Admin Review & Publish + Activation
story.domain: Form Builder, Dashboard, Publish Workflow, Public Runtime

story-context.principle: Company Admins publish and unpublish forms with stable public URLs. Forms respect activation windows (event dates) and unpublish modes. When RequirePublishApproval is false, approval workflow UI is hidden; all users publish directly.

in-scope.item: FormReviewPage: two approval options — Approve only (ready to publish later) and Approve & Publish (immediate)
On approve-and-publish or direct publish: auto-create FormPublicLink PRODUCTION; FormVersion.IsActive; stable token (one per form)
Unpublish modes: MANUAL | EVENT_END | SCHEDULED; Form.UnpublishMode, Form.ScheduledUnpublishDate; EVENT_END from Event.EndDate
Unpublished form URL: dedicated page (no 404); message + "Request admin to publish again" CTA; CTA → in-app notification to all Company Admins
Unpublish action: FormReviewPage (published form), Event Dashboard form card, form detail
Dashboard: published forms show production URL + copy; "Will unpublish on [date]" when scheduled/event-end
In-app reminders: Dashboard notice; queue items 7d/1d/on if available; email deferred
Activation windows: event-based (Event.StartDate–EndDate); public resolver shows "event ended" when outside window
When RequirePublishApproval=false: hide PendingPublishRequestsCard, Request Publish flow, FormReviewPage/review queue links; direct Publish for all users
Direct publish (admin, no request): same flow as approve-and-publish; subject to test threshold

out-of-scope.item: Email notifications for publish/unpublish — Communication/preference-center workstream

done-criteria.dc: FormReviewPage: Approve only + Approve & Publish options
On approve-and-publish / direct publish: FormPublicLink PRODUCTION created; FormVersion.IsActive; public URL works
Unpublish modes: Manual, Event end date, Schedule; Form.UnpublishMode + ScheduledUnpublishDate
Manual unpublish: form UNPUBLISHED; link deactivated. Unpublished URL: dedicated page with CTA → notify Company Admins
Dashboard: published URL + copy; "Will unpublish on [date]" badge
FormReviewPage (published): production link + copy; Unpublish button; unpublish mode/date
Direct publish uses same flow as approve-and-publish
In-app reminders for scheduled unpublish (Dashboard; queue if available)
Activation windows: event-based; public resolver "event ended" when outside window
When RequirePublishApproval=false: hide approval UI; direct publish for all
UAT guide executed and marked PASSED

existing-models.model: One PRODUCTION per form; IsActive; create on publish, deactivate on unpublish
Approve only = approved, form Ready to publish; Approve & Publish = approved + publish
Add UNPUBLISHED; DRAFT, PENDING_REVIEW, PUBLISHED, UNPUBLISHED
StartDate, EndDate — activation window; EndDate for EVENT_END unpublish
RequirePublishApproval — when false, hide approval UI

ref.purpose: Add Approve only, Approve & Publish; Unpublish
